g.text: okanetsolutions/briareus · 4 open pull requests · synced 1 min ago
Replace dialog when uploading over files
This repository has more open issues; only the most recently updated are listed.
Reference: briareus-windows. Other clients match this structure, differing only as noted here.
The header pickers are All authors ▾, All assignees ▾ (with a No assignee option) and All labels ▾, then ⟳. There is no reviewer picker on this tab.
Sub-issues sit indented under their epic, 18px per level, up to 4 levels. An epic's title starts with ◎ and it shows an 'N/M done' bar. An unnested sub-issue shows 'Part of #300 <title>'.

A click on a row opens the issue page; starting a session on it happens there. When GitHub refuses the issues, a raised box says 'GitHub would not read this repository's issues with the server's token. A fine-grained token needs
Issues: read. The pull requests are unaffected.' plus the error.
Empty states: 'No open issues.' / 'No issues match the filters.'
Region names (sidebar, canvas, raise, sunken) are the theme.* roles; widths and margins are layout.* in tokens/. Greys only, on purpose.
